We're The Branding People, a Malaysia-based digital marketing agency serving brands across Southeast Asia. We turn insights into strategy, strategy into creative work, and creative work into measurable impact.

The Brand Manager will lead our brand presence across social and digital platforms, boosting the visibility of our social media accounts and identifying the best channels and placements for ad display. The role manages a team covering AI characters, KOL talent acquisition, and UGC campaigns, while tracking performance, keeping brand messaging consistent, and working with cross-functional teams to align brand activity with business goals.

What You'll Be Crafting

  • Boost the visibility and reach of the company's social media accounts through content strategy, campaigns, and community engagement.

  • Identify opportunities on different media platforms and decide where to display ads, based on audience, format, performance, and budget.

  • Manage and mentor a team responsible for:

  • AI Character: developing and managing AI-driven brand characters and their content.

  • KOL Talent Acquisition: sourcing, negotiating with, and managing KOLs and influencers.

  • UGC Campaigns: planning and running campaigns that encourage user-generated content.

  • Track campaign performance (reach, engagement, follower growth, conversion) and report insights to management.

  • Keep brand messaging, tone, and visual identity consistent across all channels.

  • Work with cross-functional teams (product, sales, creative, performance marketing) to align brand activities with business goals.

  • Monitor platform trends, competitors, and emerging formats, and recommend new initiatives.

  • Manage the branding budget and agency or vendor relationships where applicable.

Your Superpowers

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

  • 3 - 5 years of experience in branding, social media, or digital marketing, including at least 2 years managing a team.

  • Well versed in both English and Chinese.

  • Proven track record of growing social media accounts and running KOL or influencer and UGC campaigns.

  • Knowledge of paid media and ad placement across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, and Google.

  • Familiarity with AI tools or AI-generated content, and interest in applying them to branding.

  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable with social and ad analytics tools.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.

  • Fluent in English and Bahasa Malaysia; Mandarin is an advantage.

What You'll Get Here

  • Freedom to Work from Anywhere
    Remote flexibility that empowers deep work and creative flow.

  • Upskilling That Actually Changes You
    Workshops, coaching, and exposure to brands across SEA with real learning and real growth.

  • Lucrative Pay That Reflects Value
    Competitive salary packages designed to reward excellence, not just attendance.

  • Health & Wellness Support
    Benefits that keep your mind sharp and your energy sustainable.

  • People Who Want You to Win
    A driven team that collaborates, questions, builds — and celebrates progress.

  • Plus More — Because We're Still Growing
    We refine, improve, and innovate constantly. You grow as we grow.

Franchise Brand President

Role Details
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Location: On-site (Huntersville, NC) or remote
Employment type: Full-time, exempt
Travel: Approximately 25%, based on business needs

About Us
Based in Huntersville, NC, Homefront Brands is an established platform for franchised property services businesses in North America. We have 6 brands (and growing) operating on our platform. Our mission is to be the growth engine for aspiring entrepreneurs, established business builders and our veterans to create and enhance the American dream of building a better future, through the application of our world class franchise models.

About the Opportunity

HomeFront Brands is seeking an accomplished Franchise Brand President to lead a home services franchise brand within the HomeFront Brands platform. This executive will have full accountability for the brand’s strategy, performance, franchisee success, and long-term enterprise value.
The Brand President will set a clear vision, build organizational alignment, and translate platform capabilities into profitable growth at the brand and franchisee levels. The successful candidate will combine proven brand-president leadership with deep home services experience and a strong understanding of franchise operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead brand strategy and performance: Establish the vision, strategic priorities, annual operating plan, and performance expectations for the brand.
  • Own the business: Maintain accountability for revenue growth, profitability, unit economics, budget performance, and long-term brand value.
  • Champion franchisee success: Build trusted relationships with franchise owners and ensure the organization delivers effective support, coaching, tools, and systems.
  • Drive same-store growth: Improve lead generation, sales conversion, pricing, service delivery, labor productivity, customer retention, and local market execution.
  • Accelerate network expansion: Partner with franchise development and onboarding teams to support responsible territory growth and strong new-unit performance.
  • Build a high-performing team: Recruit, develop, and retain leaders who demonstrate accountability, collaboration, urgency, and a franchisee-first mindset.
  • Leverage the HomeFront Brands platform: Collaborate across shared services and partner brands to maximize capabilities, share best practices, and create operating leverage.
  • Protect the brand: Uphold brand standards, customer experience expectations, legal and regulatory requirements, and system-wide consistency.
  • Use data to lead: Establish meaningful operating metrics, identify performance gaps, and take decisive action based on business intelligence and field insights.

Required Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Brand President, with accountability for the overall performance of a brand or business unit.
  • Demonstrated executive leadership experience in the home services industry.
  • Experience scaling a multi-location service business across multiple markets.
  • Proven success leading growth, profitability, operational improvement, and organizational change.
  • Strong command of business and financial drivers, including budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, and performance management.
  • Experience building productive relationships with franchisees, operators, field teams, and cross-functional partners.
  • Track record of developing high-performing teams and creating a culture of accountability.
  • Success using shared-service or platform capabilities to accelerate brand performance.
  • Excellent communication, judgment, executive presence, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support franchisees, employees, and brand priorities.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and executive experience.

What Success Looks Like

The successful Brand President will create strategic clarity, strengthen franchisee confidence, improve operating discipline, and build a durable path to profitable growth. Performance will be reflected in healthy franchisee economics, customer satisfaction, employee engagement, unit growth, and consistent brand execution.

HomeFront Brands is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace.

Job Title:PR Manager, Performance - Global HOKA Brand Communications

Reports to:Sr. Manager, PR - Global HOKA Brand Communications

Location: Remote - NYC or LA Preferred. Must be able to work PST hours.

Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington

The Role

As PR Manager, Performance for Global HOKA Brand Communications, you’ll lead the development and execution of global public relations strategies for performance product launches and brand campaigns. You’ll drive integrated PR strategies, messaging frameworks, and communications plans, collaborating with cross-functional teams to maximize global brand awareness and engagement. Your work will shape the narrative for HOKA’s performance products, elevate the brand’s presence, and ensure consistent storytelling across markets.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

  • Create integrated global PR strategies, messaging frameworks, and communications plans for product launches and brand initiatives
  • Lead campaign planning, storytelling development, and cross-functional alignment with Global Marketing, Product, Sports Marketing, and regional teams
  • Identify media opportunities, partnerships, and activations that drive global brand awareness and engagement
  • Lead PR strategy and execution for global events, races, product launches, and media experiences
  • Coordinate media attendance, spokesperson preparation, and onsite communications support
  • Partner with regional teams to ensure consistent execution and maximize earned media opportunities
  • Oversee proactive media outreach, interview coordination, and press responses across global markets
  • Manage HOKA's global PR agency network, including strategic direction, campaign execution, and performance
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with key performance, lifestyle, fitness, and trade media
  • Track global PR KPIs including media coverage, impressions, share of voice, and placement quality
  • Prepare executive reporting and campaign recaps with actionable insights
  • Manage PR budget forecasting, accruals, reconciliation, and vendor coordination with Finance
  • Manage and mentor direct report(s), providing coaching, feedback, and professional development
  • Serve as the primary communications partner across internal stakeholders and regional teams
  • Establish priorities, workflows, and best practices to ensure successful global campaign execution

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s Degree or above
  • 7+ years of PR/communications experience, ideally within consumer, performance, or lifestyle brands with global scope; agency or in-house experience welcomed
  • A strong network of media relationships across performance running, fitness, lifestyle, and outdoor verticals, with international media experience a plus
  • Proven ability to develop and execute integrated global PR campaigns from strategy through measurement
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with fluency in brand voice and editorial instincts that cut through across markets
  • Experience managing global agency networks and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Data-driven mindset: comfort translating KPIs and insights into actionable global communications strategy
  • Passion for the running and active lifestyle space — you understand the culture, the community, and what moves people around the world
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams across time zones and regions without losing attention to detail
  • Budget management experience and comfort with financial forecasting and reconciliation across markets
  • Willingness to travel internationally for events, activations, and races
  • Demonstrate authenticity, champion diverse and effective teams, drive strategy, cultivate innovation, deliver results, and build connection

What We'll Give You –

  • Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
  • Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
  • Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
  • Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.

About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    Provide clear strategic direction for visual assets, photography, video and design to ensure that all creative work supports a consistent and distinctive brand identity.

  10. Marketing Execution

    Personally execute priority marketing initiatives while coordinating with designers, videographers, writers or other external partners where required.

  11. Performance Measurement

    Establish appropriate brand and marketing metrics, evaluate campaign performance and use the findings to improve future strategy and execution.

  • Candidates with backgrounds in brand strategy, advertising strategy, account planning, integrated marketing or strategic communications are encouraged to apply.

About Subsense

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

Subsense · Remote first, Bay Area hybrid or on-site later · Reports to Alex Karpman, Brand & Marketing Lead

Engagement: Independent contractor, starting with a 1-month project estimated at 30 hours per week. Project scope: advance and finalize the brandbook, build social templates, create marketing materials for conferences, add slides to the master deck and create a new creative brochure.

Path to in-house: Depending on fit and business needs, Subsense may offer a full-time, in-house (W-2) Brand Designer position after the project.


The role

Subsense is building an AI-native NanoBCI: a non-surgical brain-computer interface that uses nanoparticles instead of implants. We are a team of about 40 scientists and engineers across two Bay Area labs, starting with medical applications such as Parkinson's and ALS. Our brand has to feel human, calm and clinically credible while explaining deep science and vision to investors, clinicians, press and future patients.

You will be the in-house hand behind every Subsense visual. We have brand guidelines (palette, Sora and Inter type system, gradients, chart style, logo rules). Your job is to advance them, turn them into a working system and then use that system every week, fast and consistently.

The work moves between two modes, and you should feel native in both. One day it is structured, clear and readable pitch deck slides that help investors follow complex science. The next it is creative, catchy and sometimes bold marketing materials that stop people at a conference or in a feed. Switching between them easily is the job.

Today this work is spread across several agencies and freelancers. We are bringing all of it in-house with one designer who knows the brand deeply, keeps clean source files and can turn a request around in a day when an investor meeting is tomorrow.

What you will do

  • Brand system: build and maintain our Figma library (templates, components, icons, chart styles) so every file starts on brand
  • Pitch decks and investor materials: maintain the master pitch deck, make fast slide edits for fundraising, build one-pagers and data room documents
  • Presentations: keynote and conference slides for our CEO and scientists, templates the whole team can use
  • Social media: monthly static posts, carousels, infographics and simple motion for LinkedIn and X, built on reusable templates
  • Event and conference materials: roll-up banners, booth graphics, sponsor assets, signage, badges, printed programs, ready for print vendors
  • Out of home and campaigns: billboard and digital ad creative, from concept to print-ready files
  • Merch: artwork and tech packs for caps, T-shirts and gifts
  • File hygiene: every deliverable ships with an editable native file in our shared drive, named and versioned

You might be a fit if you

  • Have a portfolio that shows brand systems, not just one-off pieces, ideally including decks and print
  • Are fluent in Figma and Canva, and comfortable in Google Slides
  • Use AI image and video tools as part of your workflow and know where they help and where they hurt quality
  • Can take a messy request ("make slide 8 clearer, tomorrow") and ask the two right questions before you start
  • Care about typography, spacing and restraint
  • Are curious about neuroscience, biotech or deep tech
  • Are reachable during California business hours (Pacific Time) and can turn quick adjustments around the same day

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with scientific or medical visuals
  • Packaging, merch or environmental design

    • How to Apply & What to Expect

    Submit your portfolio, weekly availability, and responses to four application questions, including why you’re interested in Subsense. Brief, thoughtful answers are welcome! We ask for more detail up front to keep the interview process focused and streamlined.

    Shortlisted candidates can expect:

    1. Recruiter screen — 30 minutes over Zoom to discuss your experience, interests, and the role.
    2. Test tasks + Loom walkthrough — Complete three short design tasks and present your approach in a recorded Loom video.
    3. Final hiring manager interview — 45 minutes over Zoom to discuss your work, collaboration style, and any remaining questions.

Why You’ll Thrive

You'd be joining a small team developing a non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. You’ll help translate early research into working technology, with the opportunity to influence both the platform and how we build it.

A few things that make this different:

  • Own meaningful technical work: Take projects from early R&D through functional prototypes, with room to test ideas, solve complex problems, and shape design decisions.
  • Build across disciplines: Work hands-on with ultrasound, electronics, and instrumentation alongside scientists and engineers in neuroscience, nanotechnology, and AI.
  • Help shape a novel platform: Contribute to technology with the potential to restore neurological function and, over time, enable direct brain-to-AI communication.
  • Make a visible impact: Join a team where your contributions directly influence technical progress, with equity that lets you share in the company’s growth.
Our work takes place across labs in Palo Alto and Mountain View. We offer a competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), commuter benefits, and paid time off.
Subsense is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company reinventing data security, empowering businesses to realize the full potential of their data. As the leading data security platform purpose-built for the cloud era, Cyera’s mission is to reinvent how businesses secure data, enable agile collaboration, and boldly pursue new business opportunities. Trusted by security teams at leading global businesses, our team is proving that data security is the next big thing in cyber. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data security.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Director of Brand Strategy and Storytelling to define how Cyera is understood, remembered, and chosen. You will report to the VP of Corporate Marketing and serve as a senior voice on the corporate marketing team.

You will set Cyera's brand strategy and positioning. You will lead the storytelling teams that bring it to life across Brand Content and Social. You will work with partners across marketing and creative to build a consequential brand that stands out and is clearly defined.

﻿

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Brand strategy and positioning. Define and evolve Cyera's brand platform, including purpose, positioning, narrative, and voice. Build one platform-level narrative that brings Data Security, Agent Security, and Identity Security together. Work closely with Research teams to turn original data and insight into a point of view that belongs to Cyera. Make sure Cyera is distinct from every competitor.
  • Storytelling leadership and craft. Lead Cyera's storytelling teams across Brand Content and Social. Set the standards for how Cyera tells stories, including the principles, frameworks, and editorial bar that keep the work clear, human, and credible. Set the strategic direction for bringing stories to life in multiple formats across multiple mediums, with a clear voice and steady cadence for each. Test new formats and distribution tactics, then scale the ones that work.
  • Bringing the brand to life. Partner with Creative, Design Studio, Integrated Marketing and Communications to turn strategy into campaigns, launches, events, and executive communications. Provide strong briefs and direct feedback so the brand feels like one brand. Support senior leaders with narrative for keynotes, media, and key moments.
  • Brand activation framework. Build a scalable framework for activating the brand inside and outside the company. Give employees, partners, and functions the tools, guidelines, and training to carry the brand with consistency.
  • Measurement. Build a system for measuring brand health and showing how the brand drives business impact. Own the core brand health metrics, including awareness, consideration, recall, and sentiment. Draw on brand tracking, audience insight, and content performance to sharpen strategy. Work with Demand Gen and Analytics teams to measure the brand's effect on Cyera's business and pipeline.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 12 to 15 years of experience in brand strategy, brand marketing, content strategy, or editorial leadership. B2B technology or category-defining brand experience is a plus.
  • A record of defining a brand platform or positioning that changed how a company was seen and helped it win.
  • Exceptional storytelling craft. You can write, edit, and shape a narrative yourself and raise the work of others.
  • Experience leading content and social teams and setting standards they follow.
  • Experience turning research and data into a distinctive point of view.
  • Enterprise brand experience. You can make a serious, technical brand feel human and memorable while keeping credibility with CISOs and boards.
  • AI fluency. You know where AI tools fit in strategy and storytelling, and you use them to raise quality and speed together.
  • Strong stakeholder skills. You build trust across marketing, sales, product, research, and executive teams, and you hold a point of view while balancing competing priorities.
  • People leadership. You have hired, coached, and grown senior talent, and people want to do their best work for you.
  • Operating principles that match ours (push boundaries, own and act, elevate together) and a leadership style that matches ours (model, coach, care).

﻿
